invariants.rationale: Most methods expect that a required input collection is not null at entry; method does not appear to safeguard against null.
An Option parameter is generally expected to be non-null as the wrapper; presence may be checked but null Option may indicate misuse.
Ensures that inputRecords, as a List, is in a valid state: it's either empty or not (covers all possibilities, but avoids self-comparisons).
This covers the valid contract of Option objects: they are present or not, which are the only two states.
By Java List contract, the size is always non-negative.
